svg.text: Warehouse L-cut: where the load solve dropped support, and where the break authority severed joints
Course 37 cut along the back wall and around the corner onto the chimney-end wall, front wall intact. 42 removed, 974 released, 51 joints severed. Piece centroids as laid, the instant after the cut.
released - load solve found no path to the ground (974)
removed by the cut - the L we pulled (42)
joint severed by the capacity sweep (41)
joint severed by the regional prover - the mechanism surface (10)
